# vinaypasricha.com

> An AI-native intellectual operating system for navigating a rapidly
> changing world. Books, frameworks, and conversations on how
> individuals, organisations, societies, and humanity itself can think
> more clearly inside a period of accelerating change.

## About Vinay Pasricha

Vinay Pasricha is the founder of GoodSpace AI (an AI-driven hiring
platform; 500,000+ people hired) and previously founded WLC College
India (built 1990–2020, 50,000+ alumni). He is the author of
*AI for Business Leaders*, *The SIV Method*, *The Execution Doctrine*,
*Organizational Frequency*, and *Civilization* — and is currently writing
the non-fiction *The Signal*, and a speculative-fiction cycle (working
title *Between Two Dawns*) being released here serially. Based in
Delhi, India.

## The twelve entry conversations

Each is a standalone, SEO-indexable landing page, available in 13
languages. The site uses client-side translation (Claude-powered)
served via `?lang=` URL parameters; the canonical (English) URLs are
listed here.

- [I want to use AI intelligently in my company](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/ai-for-business.html)
  — the book *AI for Business Leaders* and frameworks for AI-ready
  organisations.
- [I have a difficult decision in front of me](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/decisions.html)
  — *The SIV Method* (Socratic · Iterative · Vinay) — a framework for
  thinking under pressure.
- [I know what to do. I'm struggling to execute](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/execute.html)
  — *The Execution Doctrine* — patterns from three decades of building.
- [There is noise in my thinking and in my life](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/evolve.html)
  — *The Signal* — the upcoming book on evolving through meaningful
  conversations with AI.
- [I need to hire well for my company](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/hire.html)
  — GoodSpace AI for employers.
- [I'm looking for my next role](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/find-work.html)
  — GoodSpace AI for candidates.
- [I am at an inflection point in my career](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/career.html)
  — GoodSpace Career Management for selected professionals.
- [I want to speak with Vinay directly](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/connect.html)
  — speaking, advisory, partnerships.
- [I want to stay close to the thinking](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/blog.html)
  — *The Notebook* — one essay each month.
- [I want to learn this in a structured way](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/course.html)
  — the AI Leadership Course (Cohort III).
- [I'd like to understand who Vinay is](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/story.html)
  — the chronological journey.
- [I'd like to read your fiction](https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/fiction.html)
  — *Between Two Dawns* — a speculative cycle, released one chapter
  at a time.

## Books

- **AI for Business Leaders** (published) — a practical guide to
  building your company brain. Frameworks for the AI-ready organisation.
- **The Execution Doctrine** (published) — the grammar of getting things
  done, built from three decades of trying.
- **The SIV Method** (published) — Socratic · Iterative · Vinay. A small
  instrument for thinking under pressure.
- **The Signal** (in progress · non-fiction) — on growing through
  meaningful conversations with AI.
- **Civilization** (published · The Meridian Press) — a framework for
  evaluating the direction of intelligent civilizations: eight directions,
  four Foundations and four Frontiers. Page:
  <https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/civilization.html>
- **Between Two Dawns** (in progress · fiction · working title) — a
  three-movement speculative cycle: the dawn of humanity, the bridge of
  the present, and a future two thousand years from now. Released
  serially, one chapter each month, from June 2026.

## Languages

The site is published in 13 languages: English, हिन्दी, বাংলা, தமிழ்,
తెలుగు, ಕನ್ನಡ, Español, Français, Português, 日本語, 中文, 한국어, Русский.
Translated variants are served via `?lang=<code>` on any canonical URL
(for example, `https://vinaypasricha.com/paths/decisions.html?lang=hi`).

## How to cite

Quote the visible text on any page; the URLs are stable. For book
references, use the publisher's ISBN (listed on each book's page). For
the SIV Method, Execution Doctrine, or Signal frameworks, attribute to
"Vinay Pasricha" with a link to the relevant page.

## What this site is not

Not a personal brand. Not a thought-leadership blog. Not a consulting
funnel. Not a course platform. It is a calm signal in a noisy world —
an evolving thinking environment whose centre of gravity is the ideas,
not the individual.

## Machine readability

- Sitemap: <https://vinaypasricha.com/sitemap.xml> (includes hreflang
  alternates for all 13 languages on every URL)
- Schema.org JSON-LD is embedded on every page (Person, WebSite, and
  page-specific types — Book, FAQPage, Course, ContactPage, Blog,
  CollectionPage, ProfilePage).
- Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata are populated on every page.
- AI / LLM crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) are
  explicitly allowed in `/robots.txt`.
